title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tucker Kraft scores again in Week 8
items.desc: Tucker Kraft secured all six of his targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
items.impact: Kraft scored for the second consecutive game and the third time this season in Thursday night's win. The fourth-year TE has now caught between 4-6 passes in six straight weeks, and though he hasn't gone over 65 yards in any game this season, Kraft remains a solid TE1.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) is sitting out Friday's practice session.
items.impact: After being a limited participant on Thursday, Egbuka was not active during the morning practice session for the Buccaneers on Friday. It certainly looks like he will be a no-go once again in Week 8. Chris Godwin, Tez Johnson, and Ted Hurst III will be the main wide-receiver group for QB Bake Mayfield.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: David Bailey (ankle) doubtful for Week 8
items.desc: David Bailey (ankle) has been labeled as doubtful for Sunday's matchup with the Raiders.
items.impact: Bailey played nearly all of the defensive snaps in this past Sunday's loss to the Dolphins, but he popped up on the injury report right from the beginning of this week. The No. 2 pick in this year's draft has had a great start to his career, racking up 5.5 sacks and three forced fumbles through seven games, but it looks like he will miss his first game in Week 8. Will McDonald IV will likely see an increase in snaps.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) will remain limited at Friday's practice and is questionable for Sunday's matchup with the Raiders.
items.impact: It looks like Hall will almost certainly be on a limited snap count, even if he is able to return from a four-game absence on Sunday. Braelon Allen seems likely to shoulder the brunt of the backfield load once again for the Jets.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: T'Vondre Sweat (knee) out for Week 8
items.desc: T'Vondre Sweat (knee) will not play Sunday against the Raiders.
items.impact: Sweat sustained a knee injury in Week 7's loss to the Dolphins and will miss Week 8. Look for Darrell Jackson Jr. to see more snaps.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Trey Smack contributes three points in Week 8 win
items.desc: Trey Smack did not attempt a field goal and made 3-of-4 PATs in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
items.impact: Smack has now missed three of his 19 PATs this season, and he didn't get a chance to add any 3-pointers Thursday night. The rookie is 11-of-16 on field-goal attempts with a long of 59 yards through eight games. Smacks has put more than five points on the board just once in the last six weeks.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Packers defense racks up six sacks in Week 8 win
items.desc: The Packers D/ST held the Panthers to 19 points on 258 yards of total offense, recording six sacks and forcing two turnovers in Thursday's 27-19 win.
items.impact: The Packers have now won 4-of-5 games, giving up 20 or fewer points in all five weeks. The Green Bay defense has registered 15 sacks during that span, with six of them coming Thursday night. This is a unit still missing premier pass rusher Micah Parsons (knee), who is expected to return to practice in Week 9.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Panthers D/ST comes up with three takeaways in Thursday's loss
items.desc: The Panthers D/ST allowed 27 points on 354 yards of offense, forcing three turnovers in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
items.impact: The Panthers were not able to generate much of a pass rush, finishing Thursday's contest with zero sacks. However, the defense took the ball away twice, and the kickoff coverage unit recovered a fumble on the opening play. The Panthers also held the Packers to just 66 yards rushing on 26 attempts, but Green Bay has struggled to get the run going all season. The Panthers return home to play the Broncos in Week 9.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Ryan Fitzgerald puts seven points on the board Thursday night
items.desc: Ryan Fitzgerald made both of his field-goal attempts and his only PAT in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
items.impact: Fitzgerald has missed five PATs this season, but he remains a perfect 13-of-13 on FG tries with a long of 53 yards. The second-year kicker hit a 50-yard attempt on Thursday night and should be a decent fantasy option going forward.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tommy Tremble finishes with 19 yards Thursday night
items.desc: Tommy Tremble caught 1-of-3 targets for 19 yards in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
items.impact: Tremble hauled in a pair of touchdown passes back in Week 6. Any ideas that would lead to a big role for him going forward have now dissipated, as Tremble has just two receptions for 27 yards over the last two games combined.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Darren Waller finishes with only one reception Thursday night
items.desc: Darren Waller caught 1-of-2 targets for 11 yards in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
items.impact: Waller now has just two catches on a total of six targets over the last three weeks. Unlike in Week 7, when he scored on a 50-yard gain, the veteran TE was limited to just 11 yards in Week 8. Early on this season, it looked like Waller would be a significant contributor for the Panthers. That has now faded.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tetairoa McMillan catches six passes in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Tetairoa McMillan brought down 6-of-11 targets for 58 yards in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
items.impact: Fantasy managers in PPR formats were certainly okay with McMillan's performance in this one. The volume was there, but the Packers did a great job of limiting the second-year star's yardage. McMillan has now caught 30 passes over his last four games and is averaging exactly six per contest for the season. However, he scored both of his touchdowns in Week 4 against the Lions. He remains a high-end WR2 in most formats.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jalen Coker hits paydirt in Thursday's loss
items.desc: Jalen Coker caught just 2-of-5 targets for 36 yards, but scored a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
items.impact: Unfortunately for fantasy managers, Coker was hit with a lost fumble on an errant lateral attempt during the Panthers' last-ditch play of regulation. Still, Coker salvaged what could've been a second straight frustrating performance with a 26-yard TD play in the fourth quarter. The third-year wideout has been inconsistent on a weekly basis to this point, but he's got significant upside each time he takes the field. He's a WR3 in most standard formats.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Christian Watson deals with rib injury, eclipses 100 yards in Week 8
items.desc: Christian Watson hauled in 8-of-10 targets for 113 yards in Thursday night's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
items.impact: Watson's performance was impressive enough without considering that he reportedly broke a rib, went to the hospital, and still returned before the end of the game. Adding all that into the equation, this was nothing short of a Herculean effort. Watson led the Pack in receptions and yards, recording a new season-high in the former column. The fifth-year pro is finally putting together the type of breakout campaign many have been waiting for, and he'll have a couple extra days to try to heal up before Week 9's game in New England.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) eyeing a return to practice in Week 9
items.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) is expected to return to the practice field in Week 9.
items.impact: Parsons has not played since Week 15 of last season, as he has been recovering from a torn ACL and meniscus. The three-time All-Pro is reportedly progressing toward a return to Packers' practice next week, however. Parsons racked up 12.5 sacks over 14 games in his first season with the Packers last year.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: John Metchie III hauls in three short passes Thursday
items.desc: John Metchie III caught all three of his targets for just 14 yards in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
items.impact: Metchie remains involved in the Panthers' offense, as he's caught 2-3 passes in each of the last five games. There's just not too much fantasy appeal in that, particularly since Metchie is averaging just 9.5 yards per reception with a long of 18. Leave him on the waiver wire.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Chuba Hubbard gains 119 yards, scores in Thursday's loss
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 81 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, adding 38 yards on seven receptions in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
items.impact: Hubbard delivered a true workhorse effort Thursday night and was certainly one of the main reasons the Panthers hung around until the end of this contest. Hubbard is having a strong season through seven games, averaging 20 touches for close to 100 yards of offense. He has also found the end zone in five of those games.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Bryce Young throws one touchdown, one pick in Thursday's loss
items.desc: Bryce Young completed 23 of 41 passes for 209 yards with one touchdown and one interception in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
items.impact: Young put up a so-so performance overall in Green Bay on Thursday night. Considering he was absolutely harassed by the Packers' pass rush, going down for six sacks, his output could've, and probably should've, been much worse. Still, since a strong start to the season, it's been a tough couple of weeks for Young in back-to-back losses. Things won't get any easier against the Broncos' defense in Week 9.

items.impact: This appears to be a new injury for Williams. He will need to be monitored in practice the next couple of days.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (ankle) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. (ankle) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mims was able to practice in full on Thursday after being limited by an ankle issue on Wednesday. He should be a full go for Week 8 but doesn't project to be fantasy relevant in this matchup against the Chiefs.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: RJ Harvey (knee) added to injury report Thursday
items.desc: RJ Harvey (knee) was added to the injury report as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Harvey is a new addition to Denver's injury report, being listed with a knee issue of some kind that left him limited at practice. This is a situation worth monitoring heading into the weekend, as J.K. Dobbins and rookie Jonah Coleman will both see more work if Harvey is sidelined against the Chiefs.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (chest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle (chest) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Waddle was a non-participant on Wednesday due to his chest injury, but he was able to make his return to practice on Thursday and was officially a limited participant. It seems like he will have a good chance to play on Sunday, though we don't yet know his official status for that game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Travis Kelce (ankle) downgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Travis Kelce (ankle) was downgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kelce was a full participant to start the week on Wednesday, but he was downgraded to limited on Wednesday due to his ankle issue. This may very well be nothing more than an injury management move on the part of the team, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't have any concern for his availability unless he carries an injury designation heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Sneed was listed as limited on Thursday. He's still nursing a nagging knee issue, but it doesn't seem likely to leave him sidelined in Week 8. Kansas City's secondary will be stronger if he's available to play for them.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie was added to the injury report on Thursday as a non-participant because of a shoulder issue of some kind. This may just be an injury management move on the part of the team, however, so Friday's injury report will tell us more about his actual status for Week 8.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Rice was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He has missed a couple of games due to a pair of injuries that he's managing, but he seems to be trending the right direction for Week 8. He will be startable if active on Sunday, though his slow start to the season makes him less than a must-start option.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Ed Oliver (knee) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Oliver was a full participant on Thursday after being limited by a knee issue on Wednesday. It looks like he's a full go for Week 8, which will be great news for Buffalo's defensive front ahead of a tough matchup against the Ravens.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ray Davis (illness) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Ray Davis (illness) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Davis came down with an illness of some kind and wasn't able to practice on Thursday after being a full go on Wednesday. He's likely to be cleared to play in time for Sunday's game and is expected to remain nothing more than a depth piece on this offense for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Kincaid (chest) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid (chest) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kincaid was a limited participant at practice on Thursday. This was his second-straight limited practice, which means that he could end up carrying an injury designation heading into the weekend. Friday's official injury report should give us more information on his status ahead of Week 8.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) limited again Thursday
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) was limited in practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Moore is still managing a nagging shoulder issue and was limited at practice again on Thursday as a result. He is likely to play through it in Week 8 coming off of the bye week, however,  but it remains to be seen if he will carry any sort of injury designation heading into the weekend or not.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Allegretti (back) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Nick Allegretti (back) was sidelined at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Allegretti is a new addition to Washington's injury report. He is now dealing with a back issue and is at risk of being sidelined in Week 8 because of it. If he's out, Washington's offensive front will be weaker than usual in a matchup against the Eagles on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Stefon Diggs (hand/hamstring) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Stefon Diggs (hand/hamstring) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to log a full practice session on Thursday. He was held out of Wednesday's practice due to a pair of issues, but neither of them are considered serious at this point. He remains a safe flex option in most league formats for the foreseeable future.
